ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows triangle ABC, with C at the lower left, B at the upper left, and A at the lower right; BC is vertical, CA is horizontal, and AB is the hypotenuse from B to A. Point M is marked on hypotenuse AB, and dashed segment CM connects from C to M. The angle between AC and AB at point A is marked as 60°, and the problem text gives ∠BCA = 90° and M is the midpoint of hypotenuse AB. Reasoning: In right triangle ABC, the midpoint M of hypotenuse AB is equidistant from the three vertices A, B, C, so MA = MC. Because M is on AB, ray AM is collinear with AB, therefore ∠MAC is the ∠BAC = 60° marked in the figure. In triangle AMC, MA = MC, so it is an isosceles triangle; also ∠MAC = 60°, so triangle AMC is actually an equilateral triangle, therefore ∠AMC = 60°. Since A, M, B are collinear, MB is the opposite ray of MA, so ∠BMC and ∠AMC are supplementary, ∠BMC = 180° - 60° = 120°.

raw_record.question_text: The triangle pictured is right-angled. $M$ is the midpoint of the hypotenuse $\mathrm{AB}$ and $\angle \mathrm{BCA}=90^{\circ}$. How big is $\angle \mathrm{BMC}$?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A, M, and B lie on the same slanted side AB, C is the right-angle vertex, the dashed segment CM is drawn, and the angle at A between AC and AB is marked 60°. From the text, use that M is the midpoint of hypotenuse AB in right triangle ABC. Apply the right-triangle midpoint-of-hypotenuse theorem: M is equidistant from A, B, and C, so MA = MC. Since AM lies along AB, angle MAC equals the marked angle BAC = 60°. Thus triangle AMC is isosceles with MA = MC and has a 60° base angle, so it is equilateral and angle AMC = 60°. Because MB is the opposite ray of MA on the straight line AB, angle BMC is supplementary to angle AMC, giving 180° - 60° = 120°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，C 在左下方，B 在左上方，A 在右下方；BC 竖直，CA 水平，AB 是从 B 到 A 的斜边。点 M 标在斜边 AB 上，虚线段 CM 从 C 连到 M。A 点处 AC 与 AB 之间的角被标为 60°，题目文字给出 ∠BCA = 90° 且 M 是 hypotenuse AB 的 midpoint。

推理：在直角三角形 ABC 中，斜边 AB 的中点 M 到三个顶点 A、B、C 距离相等，所以 MA = MC。因为 M 在 AB 上，射线 AM 与 AB 同线，因此 ∠MAC 就是图中标出的 ∠BAC = 60°。在三角形 AMC 中，MA = MC，所以它是等腰三角形；又 ∠MAC = 60°，可得三角形 AMC 实际为等边三角形，因此 ∠AMC = 60°。由于 A、M、B 共线，MB 是 MA 的反向射线，所以 ∠BMC 与 ∠AMC 互补，∠BMC = 180° - 60° = 120°。
